g.text: The added routing table now occupies editable cells
2D example · one fixed interpreter reads both tables
Numbers 0–7 are bit addresses; each box stores P0 or P1.
One edit to h changes one physical program cell.
The next lift inherits both r and h, then adds
a third table along the new axis.
Data neighbors are nine physical spacings from C. Other macrocells’ program cells are omitted.
Five symbols · radius nine · 17 occupied sites per 2D macrocell · axis assignments remain fixed
